2026-10-23.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Fixed roof overhang collider behavior and added proper ColliderInfo to overhangs and frames, preventing incorrect collisions when building.
- Corrected the toast notification shown when rotating boat building blocks.
- Buildings no longer split when blocks are flipped; rotation and flip checks now account for final orientation, fixing mirrored stairs issues and the 10‑minute flip window reset bug.
- Demolish option now correctly requires building privilege and shows an informative toast when disabled.
- Enabled the Scrap King building skin in standalone mode.

### Tools & Item Balance
- Shears now yield 25% more wool, have 200% knife durability, and deal 50% less damage.

### World & Creatures
- Plants grown on boats remain visible while sailing by using dynamic renderers.
- Animals no longer automatically turn toward the player when petted, preventing them from getting stuck.

### Player Items & Skins
- First‑join bug fixed: spawned rocks and torches now use the selected skin instead of the default.

### Delivery Pod Vehicle
- DPV radial menu now shows Mount, Fuel, and Pickup; condition persists after pickup; acceleration speed doubled; fuel consumption reduced from 0.15 → 0.08 /s and idle fuel usage lowered.

items.text: Rotate and flip now share a slot in the pie menu; E/Q toggles between them while preserving muscle memory and adjusting building tiers accordingly.
Stair blocks and colliders updated for the Scrap King DLC, improving geometry, collision handling, and block behavior.
Softcore mode now disables the deployable corpse system and raises the maximum team count from 3 to 6; the main menu changelog reflects the new limit.
Introduced a Croc Pie recipe that uses the new animal repellent modifier, with accompanying UI updates and a richer version.
Fixed a server collider bug so sails no longer have both lowered and raised colliders active after spawning, preventing unexpected collisions.
Resolved an issue where lamps on player boats disappeared after moving away from the activation point due to dynamic marking problems.
Quit button functionality restored.
Reworded and inverted the inventory/crafting D‑Pad configuration description to reduce confusion.
Fixed a stray cart button appearing in the skin viewer when opened from the Steam inventory.
Spray can no longer becomes unusable after quickly looking away; re‑equip is no longer required and the extra third‑person animation was removed.
Fixed a bug that allowed non‑admin players to be killed in Halloween dungeons.

2026-10-22.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Rotate and flip now share a slot in the pie menu; E/Q toggles between them while preserving muscle memory and adjusting building tiers accordingly.
- Stair blocks and colliders updated for the Scrap King DLC, improving geometry, collision handling, and block behavior.

### Gameplay Modes & New Content
- Softcore mode now disables the deployable corpse system and raises the maximum team count from 3 to 6; the main menu changelog reflects the new limit.
- Introduced a Croc Pie recipe that uses the new animal repellent modifier, with accompanying UI updates and a richer version.

### Boat & Sailing Improvements
- Fixed a server collider bug so sails no longer have both lowered and raised colliders active after spawning, preventing unexpected collisions.
- Resolved an issue where lamps on player boats disappeared after moving away from the activation point due to dynamic marking problems.

### UI & Inventory Enhancements
- Quit button functionality restored.
- Reworded and inverted the inventory/crafting D‑Pad configuration description to reduce confusion.
- Fixed a stray cart button appearing in the skin viewer when opened from the Steam inventory.

### Gameplay Bug Fixes
- Spray can no longer becomes unusable after quickly looking away; re‑equip is no longer required and the extra third‑person animation was removed.
- Fixed a bug that allowed non‑admin players to be killed in Halloween dungeons.

items.text: Triangle foundations can now be placed on top of brutalist ramps.
Destroying chicken coops no longer leaves items stuck or fail to kill the coop entity.
Apple trees (oak_e) no longer drop apples every harvest and loot refreshes on natural beehives, apple and coconut trees have been removed, fixing inconsistent fruit drops.
Bird flocks now exhibit reactive swarm behavior, avoiding obstacles and players with more realistic flight patterns.
Added right‑side icons to the map screen with d‑pad navigation and tooltips, improving map UI usability.
Fixed aim offset on the 9mm UZI, correcting shooting accuracy.

2026-10-21.summary:
### Base Building
- Triangle foundations can now be placed on top of brutalist ramps.
- Destroying chicken coops no longer leaves items stuck or fail to kill the coop entity.

### Resources & Farming
- Apple trees (oak_e) no longer drop apples every harvest and loot refreshes on natural beehives, apple and coconut trees have been removed, fixing inconsistent fruit drops.

### Animals & AI
- Bird flocks now exhibit reactive swarm behavior, avoiding obstacles and players with more realistic flight patterns.

### UI & Navigation
- Added right‑side icons to the map screen with d‑pad navigation and tooltips, improving map UI usability.

### Weapons
- Fixed aim offset on the 9mm UZI, correcting shooting accuracy.
